trust_decision.summary: Conversion of a local-time YYYYMMDD[HHMM[SS]] string into the epoch seconds stored as certificate/signer validity bounds; decided in parse_absolute_time(), where mktime is told to determine DST (tm_isdst = -1). At the pinned commit this DST handling is ALREADY present; the listed fix commit does not touch it.

landing_point.why: Summary names ssh-keygen certificate expiration; the -V validity parser calls parse_absolute_time for from/to, which leads to misc.c:2557.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the listed fix commit only replaces a ksh-only glob pattern in regress/percent.sh (fix.diff:13-14) and changes no source; the real DST fix (aef20dfe, ChangeLog:764-775) is already in the pinned tree at misc.c:2609.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Explicit UTC inputs (trailing Z/UTC) go through timegm and must not get DST-adjusted; relative (+/-) and 0x hex forms bypass parse_absolute_time.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: allowed_signers valid-after/valid-before could use its own local-time conversion that does not set tm_isdst.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Signer-file option parsing is separate code from ssh-keygen -V and a maintainer could have parsed it inline.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: authorized_keys expiry-time could be parsed by a server-side copy of the conversion that does not handle DST.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: sshd option parsing lives in a different module from ssh-keygen; a duplicate helper there would be plausible.

O9_family: time/date conversion off-by-one-hour (DST mishandling, CWE-193); not integer overflow

O10_build.project_tests: regress/unittests/misc/test_convtime.c:97-150 (parse_absolute_time; notes DST is not verified at :95), regress/cert-*.sh

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set tm_isdst = -1 before mktime in parse_absolute_time, which is already done at misc.c:2609.

out_of_scope_notes: Advisory-to-commit mapping is wrong: fix commit a8c72b84 only rewrites a ksh-ism in regress/percent.sh:34; the pinned tree is already OpenSSH_10.6 (version.h:3), the release the advisory says contains the fix.
unverified: Whether any other DST-related change in 10.6 exists beyond aef20dfe was not checked.
Recall risk is a guess: the bug is in the public OpenSSH release notes and bz4004.
